t: This was Cramer and Company, a London music shop and instrument maker with premises on New Bond Street. It was founded in 1824 by the musician Johann Baptist Cramer. He was an English pianist, composer and music publisher of German origin, and the son of the well-known London violinist Wilhelm Cramer. The firm made instruments, published music and sold it. Its New Bond Street premises closed in 1964, when the company was taken over by Kemble and Company.
